tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Mistral's ML4 model, trained on 4,000 GPUs, debuts with 1-trillion parameters targeting cyber and industrial tasks. Confirmed by Briefs Finance: the open capabilities compete in the market.
Mistral unveils the Large 4 model with 1-trillion parameters, claiming an edge over Chinese rivals. Confirmed by Crypto Briefing: public release comes on October 27.
OpenAI plans to release hundreds of solved math problems on GitHub following a meeting with mathematicians. Confirmed by Wired: the move addresses mathematician concerns.
Utah mandates artificial intelligence literacy training for government employees under a pro-human artificial intelligence framework. Confirmed by KUTV: the order integrates training across state government.
Wajo leads the personal-agent race with a trust-first design, operating in 107 countries and growing 10x since launch. Confirmed by TechCrunch: Vinod Khosla believes it will win the agent market.
Free every hour.
